_comment: The portal's display configuration (brief WP-17). Every value is overridable by the environment named beside it (deploy/ENV.md, web). None is a judgement: thresholds, radii and limits come from the API's answers.

map._comment: The maps' first view (USSP_WEB_MAP_CENTER as lng,lat; USSP_WEB_MAP_ZOOM): Tbilisi as the national default view, pending GCAA.

geo._comment: How much wider than the map's view the box of GET /v1/geo and GET /v1/weather is, as a fraction of the view (a display choice; the API caps a box at 5 degrees a side and says so).

bff._comment: The upstream timeout of every BFF call (USSP_WEB_BFF_TIMEOUT_MS) and the session cookie's lifetime, never longer than the API's session (at most 12 h, M20; the kit shortens it to the session's expires_at).

accessibility._comment: The portal's accessibility target: the spec's default, pending GCAA.
